Fat MTB
Production Frame
All the best parts of our distinctive Bonestealer MTB frame, hulked out to clear 26x4.8 tires. Ready for sand, snow, dirt, or whatever adventure springs to mind.
Unsolicited customer review:
“Dave and crew at Ti Cycles Fabrication, thank you for the finest fat tire bike made. Since acquiring the Pygmy Bryde in June, I've been riding single track in Oregon National Forests, and it's never been so easy. It's like cheating, not kidding! I've been riding mountain bikes since 1984, and have ridden some high-end bikes, but never one that climbed and descended so well, and at the same time so light. Steep descents are all of a sudden easily controlled; I have to be going really fast to get it to wash out even a little. Because of the frame geometry and fat tires, steep accents are likewise easy: just stand up and horse the handlebars with no rear wheel slippage. As it weighs less than most suspended bikes (heck less than most bikes period), it's also a switchback dream.
Your custom frame fit and one piece handlebar/stem, made to my dimensions, are unavailable elsewhere. The titanium fork and carbon rims keep the bike nimble yet indestructible. And one thing that makes this bike stand out in the field is esthetics. The curved top and down tubes are rarely if ever seen in fat tire titanium frames (with room for a top tube bike pack I might add). While there are a few titanium fat tire bikes out there -and I looked at them all - none compare.
I've attached a photo of the bike on the edge of Winter Rim, Fremont Winema National Forest, so readers can see what I'm talking about.
Dave, please thank all involved with putting this piece of performance art together.” — Jeff S. 08.21
